chunks: And whoever of my slave girls

who were under me, if any one of them has a child or is pregnant, she will be retained for the sake of the child and will form part of his share. If the child dies and she survives, then she is free, bondage is removed from her and liberty is given to her.

key_terms.أَطُوفُ عَلَيْهِنَّ: I am under their authority / they are under me

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling for a female slave who bears a child in Islam?
ai.summary: This ruling establishes the status of 'Umm al-Walad' (mother of the child), ensuring that a female slave who bears her master's child cannot be sold or transferred until the child reaches maturity, thereby securing her lineage and status. Upon the child's death, her manumission becomes immediate and absolute, reflecting the Prophetic tradition of gradual emancipation and the spiritual merit of freeing slaves, a practice Imam Ali emphasized during his return from Siffin to consolidate his administrative and ethical reforms.
